Commentary.Commentary: DILRUWAN PERERA comes on to bowl.

That completes a good batting performance by Sri Lanka after opting to bat. Kusal Mendis was the star performer yesterday and got going today although he missed out on a double ton. Gunaratne and Dickwella stroked fluent fifties as well while Perera chipped in with a half-century as well. Mehedi was the most successful bowler for Bangladesh with a 4-fer but generally the bowling wasn't up to the mark from Bangladesh, especially yesterday. They will be happy to have restricted Sri Lanka inside 500 but the pitch has started to show some tricks. Start will be crucial for the visitors. The second innings isn't far away. Stay tuned.

OUT! Shakib Al Hasan finally gets a wicket! Floats it up around off, gives it a nice amount of flight, Sandakan tries to clear Galle and as a result dances down the track to have a go at it. The bat seems to have turned in his hands and he miscues it high in the air towards extra cover. Mehedi from mid off runs across to his left, keeps his eyes on the ball and stretches both his hands to take a spectacular catch. SRI LANKA BOWLED OUT FOR 494!
Tossed up around off, Kumara presses forward and defends it down.
LAHIRU KUMARA is the last man in!
Drinks break!!!

OUT! MEHEDI HAS HIS FOURTH! Flatter around off, Perera misses the sweep and is struck on the pads. Big appeal for lbw and it's given by the umpire. Looked quite close to the naked eye. He opts for the review. Legal delivery and no bat involved. Hawk Eye shows the impact in line and hitting off stump. Perera can continue his walk to the pavilion. Decent knock from the off spinner.
Perera has been adjudged LBW by Erasmus. He wants to refer it upstairs...
Drops it short on middle, gets on the back foot and mistimes the pull to short fine leg for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, sits back and nudged it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Four Byes! That's sneaked through! Lovely break on middle, spins sharply down the leg side, Das fumbles and it goes away to the fine leg fence. Byes signaled.
Flighted outside off, gets well forward to that one and blocks it down the track.
MEHEDI HASAN is back on!
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and blocks well.
Flighted on middle, uses his feet and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Darted on middle, gets back and clips it on the leg side for a single.
Slider around off, leans forward to block but gets a faint inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it.
Flatter ball around off, defends it well from the crease.
Full toss on middle and leg, whipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, leans forward and drives it through the covers for a brace.
Back of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, Sandakan flashes at it but misses.
On around off, Perera looks to push at it but gets an inside edge just past the stumps towards fine leg for a single.
3rd Test fifty for Dilruwan Perera!

FOUR! Top shot! That's a stroke straight out of the top drawer. Overpitched ball outside off, Perera leans into it and creams it through the covers. Timed it ever so well and the ball rockets to the fence for a boundary.
Drifting in from around off, solidly defended from the crease.
Fuller outside off, presses forward to that one and blocks solidly.
Flatter around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN is the new man in!

OUT! GONE! Funny people I tell you! Drifting in on a length outside off, pushed gently towards short third man. Big mix up between the batsmen, Lakmal wanted the run but his partner was never interested. He kept going and ended up at the same end as Perera. Mustafizur's throw came accurately at Das who had all the time in the world to whip off the bails. Waste of a wicket although it won't affect SL much.
Slider around off, leans across to block but is struck on the pads. Stifled lbw appeal but turned down.
Flatter outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks it to short cover.
Touch short and outside off, Suranga pulls it one-legged towards the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on middle, this time Lakmal is on to it in a flash. Gets back and pulls it firmly through mid-wicket. There was a fielder in the deep but could do nothing about it.
Very full and wide outside off, Lakmal crouches low to drive but is beaten all ends up.
Fuller on off, defended off the front foot to cover.
Once again slants it in from around off, Suranga looks to pull it across the line but once again misses ans is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal for an LBW! Probably, missing the stumps.
Angles it in on the pads, Lakmal looks to flick but the ball bounces and hits him on the stomach.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
That's hit the batsman on his pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Angling in from outside off, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! Shot! Fuller and outside off, reaches out and drills it through the covers for a boundary.
Slider on middle, pings Lakmal on the pad but he has got a faint inside edge on it. Stifled lbw appeal dies down.
Flatter around off, gets across to push at it but gets an inside edge through square leg for a run.
Drifting in on middle and leg, leans across and works it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, reaches out and pats it towards the covers.
Flighted outside off, leans forward and drives it powerfully towards short cover.
Flatter outside off, steps out to that one and pats it towards short cover.
Back of a length on middle and leg, gets on the back foot and defends it down the pitch.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and pats it towards the covers.
Length ball closer to off, this one comes in with the angle as Perera tries the cut but misses. Got cramped for room there.
Good length outside off, sits on the back foot and defends strongly towards cover.
Fuller this time and a bit wider outside off, Perera tries the expansive drive but is beaten.
Good length just outside off, angling in, straightens a bit after pitching as Perera lets it pass.
Loopy and outside off, reaches out and drives it firmly towards cover.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out and blocks solidly.
Floated on middle, gets across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Flatter on a length on middle, sits back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace. The wild throw at the bowler's end helps the batsmen's cause.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Perera motors along. Floated outside off, he steps out and lofts it cleanly over mid on. Well struck and that races to the fence.
Another leg cutter on middle, Lakmal gets across and blocks firmly on to the track.
Very full and outside off, Perera drives it sweetly through point for a run.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Perera hangs back and blocks the leg cutter.
Fuller and outside off, drives it through point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Lakmal tries to push at it but misses.
Good length on off, gets back and works it back to the bowler down the track.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks well.
Flatter outside off, sits back and defends it solidly.
Floated on leg stump, Perera looks to block but is struck on the pads. Muted appeal for lbw but it was missing leg.
Drifting in from outside off, pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Flighted around off, leans forward and blocks it down the track.
Flatter and short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN to bowl from the other end.
Good length outside off, this time Lakmal doesn't offer a shot.
Length ball outside off, Lakmal throws his bat at it but is beaten again.
Squared up! All of a sudden, the pitch is playing tricks. Extra bounce off the deck again and Lakmal is beaten on the poke.
Full and outside off, Lakmal blocks it solidly off the front foot.
SURANGA LAKMAL is the next batsman in, replcing Herath!

OUT! GOT HIM! Cracking delivery from Mustafizur again and this time he gets rewarded. Good length angled in closer to off, straightens after pitching with extra bounce off the deck. Herath pushes at it tamely and the ball flies off the top half of the blade towards first slip where Sarkar takes a simple catch. Second wicket for Mustafizur. There is some life in the pitch out of nowhere.
In the air but safe! Full and angled away around off, extra bounce as Perera pushes at it. Gets a thick edge that goes through backward point for a single. That reared off the deck.
Floated outside off, reaches out to that one and defends.
FOUR! Cheeky from Rangana! He is having fun out there in the middle. The reverse sweep this time and he connects well to get it towards deep backward point fence.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and blocks it.
FOUR! CLOBBERED! That made a cracking sound off the bat. Floated outside off, Herath gets down on one knee and fetches it to wallop the sweep through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floated around off, defended solidly from the crease.
Floated outside off, a bit of turn away as Herath plays well inside the line.
MEHEDI HASAN to bowl from the other end.
Good length closer to off, blocked solidly from the crease.

Back of a length outside off, sits back and defends it solidly.
On middle and leg, gets across and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Good length closer to off, stays back and pats it back to the bowler.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Short and wide outside off, Herath starts with a flourish, slashes it through backward point for a boundary. That was like dessert after the heavy lunch he must have had.
Welcome back for the second session. How many more can Sri Lanka score? Let's wait and see. MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN to begin proceedings after lunch.
.....DAY 2, SESSION 2.....

Another session to Sri Lanka. Mendis and Dickwella continued the assault against the Bangladeshi bowlers with some enterprising batting. Both departed just before their double century and century respectively but had done the damage. Perera has got going too and the hosts will hope to add as many as possible to their tally. Mehedi Hasan picked up both the wickets to fall but it was Roy again who bowled well, albeit without luck. Bangladesh will hope to restrict the hosts inside 500 which would be damage control. Join us in a while for the second session.
Mehedi nicely tosses it up around off, Dilruwan Perera presses forward and blocks it out on the off side. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Slower through the air around off, Perera buries it into the ground.
Flighted around off, defended towards the leg side.
Pushed quicker through the off side, it's clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Comes forward and blocks it out gently.
Flattish around middle and leg, worked away towards the leg side.
For the last ball of the over, switches the angle as he comes from around the wicket, bangs in another short ball, Perera moves inside the line and leaves it alone.
DP defends it from within the crease.
Another short ball by Roy, Perera drops is wrists to let it be.
Good length around off, pushed towards covers off the front foot.
Short again on outside off, Perera is happy to sit under it.
Shortish in length and served on middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Rangi presses forward, keeps his bat close to the pad and smothers it away on the off side.
Slower through the air and spinning away, Herath plays inside the line as the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower one around off, defended into the ground.
Pushes it flatter around off, Herath stays back to defend but gets an inside edge.
Quicker through the air outside off, it's left alone by the Lankan skipper.

FOUR! Edged and through! Roy once again hits the deck hard and the ball rises a bit more than the batsman anticipated it to be. He hops back and hangs his bat around but gets a thick outside edge wide of the first slip fielder who puts in a dive to his right but the ball goes through for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, DP ducks to evade it.
FOUR! Sweet! Gets a gentle half-volley, prods forward and presents a straight bat to send it past Roy at mid on. The fielder gives it a chase but comes second best to the ball.
Angles it in on middle and leg, Perera stays leg side to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Full on off, punched towards the man at short extra cover.
RANGANA HERATH is the new man in.

OUT! Top edge, gone! Dickwella missing out on a ton now! Serves a flighted ball around off, Dickwella comes down the track to crack it across the line but is beaten by the flight and turn here. Gets a thick top edge as the ball balloons in the air towards backward point where Mahmudullah stays put and takes an easy catch without moving an inch. Mehedi gets his third.
Another flat ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a comfortable two.
Flatter one around middle and leg, flicked towards backward square leg for a single.
Quicker through the air, skidding through the surface, Perera looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.

SIX! Down the track and away she goes! Hasan floats it up on the stumps, once again Perera advances down the track and picks it up elegantly to send it sailing over the mid-wicket fence for another maximum.
Full around middle and leg, Dickwella comes down the track and works it towards mid on for a brisk single. That's also his highest score in this format now!
Fuller on off, a solid front foot defense on offer from Dilruwan.
Fuller and moving away a touch, DP prods forward to defend but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards gully.
Wide! Hits the deck hard and gets a good amount of bounce but much to his dismay it goes well over the head of the batsman. Called a wide.
Fuller in length and very close to the off stump channel, Dilruwan shoulders his arms to that one.
Back of a length ball, in the channel outside off, cut square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Short of a length ball outside off, Perera gets on the toes and slaps it over point for a single.
Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Dilruwan sits under the bumper.
Touch short and around the pads, clipped past short leg. The square leg fielder quickly gets to his left and keeps them down to a single.
Allows the ball to turn and defends it down safely.
Sees the batsman stepping out and hence fires it full outside off, it's jammed past the man at covers for a single.
Very full around middle and leg, flicked past the man at short mid-wicket for a single.
Drops it short around off, Niroshan camps back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Roy in the deep does well to stop it inside the rope. Three runs added to the total.
Gives it a lot of air and serves it outside off, Dickwella reaches out to that one and drives it towards the cover fielder.

Good length just around off, Dilruwan covers the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Back of a length ball outside off, Perera looks to cut it away but gets beaten completely.
Leg bye! Fuller and nips back in a touch, Dickwella shuffles across to flick but misses as the ball rolls off the pads towards square leg. They take a leg bye.
Back of a length ball outside off, tapped towards the off side off the back foot.
Comes from around the wicket and angles it on middle, it's defended by covering the line.
SUBASHIS ROY is back on.
Floats it up around off, DP lunges forward and buries it into the ground.
Short and turning in a bit, Perera looks to work it on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
DP presses forward in defense again.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Tonk! Tossed up around middle, Dilruwan jumps down the track, meets the pitch of the ball and hoicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Clean strike!
Full around off, defended down into the ground.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Quicker through the air around off, Perera comes down the track and pads it away.
Around middle and leg, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Once again it's on a flatter trajectory, Dickwella camps back and punches it through covers for a brace.
Short and outside off, punched towards covers for another single.
Tossed up, spinning in, flicked through square leg for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Good shot! Loopy ball around off, Perera comes down the track and lofts it cleanly over mid on for a one bounce boundary.
Full around off, defended down towards the off side.
DILRUWAN PERERA is the new man in.

OUT! Lovely catch! Kusal Mendis walks back disappointed! Mehedi tosses it up around off, Mendis tries to be Sehwag as he wants to get to the milestone with a biggie. Skips down the track to go downtown but miscues it high in the air. Tamim Iqbal at long on stays calm as a cucumber, sees where exactly the rope is, takes the catch. Now, the momentum takes him back but he shows good presence of mind as he tosses the ball up, goes inside the ropes and then quickly gets back in to take it. He was confident enough that he has taken it cleanly. However, umpire Aleem Dar wants to check it upstairs. Replays confirm it's a clean take. Mendis will have to wait for his maiden double ton.
Tamim Iqbal has taken the catch but the umpire wants to see if it's taken cleanly or not. Soft signal is out!
Sees the flight, comes down the track and milks it down to long off for a single.
Floats it up around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Darts it around middle and leg, nudged behind square on the leg side for another single. 11 off the over.
FOUR! Nicely done! Gets down and across to this tossed up ball and sweeps it ever so cleanly to deep square leg to pick up another boundary. Shakib already taken for runs in his very first over.
Comes down the track and works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Loopy delivery served outside off, Dickwella gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it past first slip for a boundary towards third man.
100-run stand is up between Dickwella and Mendis!
Tossed up around middle and off, tucked through square leg for one.
Comes from over the wicket and loops it up outside off, ND brooms it through mid-wicket for a single.
Spin from both ends now as SHAKIB AL HASAN is brought into the attack for the first time today!
Floats it up around off, defended off the front foot.
Ouch! That must have hurt! Tossed up outside off, Dickwella gets down to sweep but it hits Mominul at short leg and the ball parries towards mid-wicket. They take a single.
Loopy ball around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Floats it up around middle and off, Niroshan comes down the track to defend but gets hit on the pads.
Around middle and leg, flicked nicely off the pads towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Dickwella comes down the track and works it just past short leg for a single.
Drinks break....
Good length around off, blocked solidly towards mid off.
Length ball on middle, gets across and defends solidly down the track.
Fuller on middle, gets across and works it towards mid on.
2nd Test fifty for Niroshan Dickwella!
Back of a length outside off, Dickwella gets back and glides it to third man for a single. It's been a counterattacking knock from him.

NOT OUT! Back of a length around leg stump, Dickwella shuffles across the sticks to whip it through the leg side but is struck on the pads. Huge appeal for lbw but turned down. Bangladesh after some thought opt for the review. Where that pitched would be interesting to see. Legal delivery, it's pitching outside leg and that settles the issue. The on-field call will stay.

Full and wide outside off, driven sweetly through point for a brace.
SIX! THAT'S BEEN MAULED! Tossed up around off, Mendis gets down on one knee and nails the slog sweep way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. That went way into the stands. Meaty blow!

Players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Bangladesh badly need a good first session to stay afloat in this game. The mantra for Sri Lanka would be simple - bat on and on. KUSAL MENDIS on strike, SUBASHIS ROY to start proceedings on day 2. Two slips in place.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold reckons that it is still a very good batting surface with no real demons in it barring the scratches near the crease. The newish ball might be the only solace Bangladesh have but otherwise, it seems a good pitch to bat on. Spin may come into play perhaps only after day three.

Bangladesh did manage to keep the hosts under check in the first session but that was all for them. They would look to pick up quick wickets so that they can restrict the home side to a manageable total. If they don't, another long day beckons. Let's see how day 2 pans out. Stay tuned as the action is about to resume...

Hello and a warm welcome for the second day of this Test match between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. The hosts have tightened their grip as they are on the verge of scoring a healthy first innings total. Yesterday was all about Kusal Mendis who made full use of the life that he got and is now closing in on his maiden Test double ton. He has Dickwella for company who has looked solid the moment he stepped in.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1...

Roy was the pick of the bowlers while Taskin was probing once the second new ball was taken. However, overall the Bangladeshi bowling appeared toothless after the first session and gradually allowed the game to slip away from them. The first session will be vital for them tomorrow and if they can make the newish ball count, they could limit the damage. Otherwise, they could be staring at a very big score. Join us at 1000 local, 0430 GMT for the second day's play. Until then, it's goodbye from us.

Excellent final session for the Lankans and they take the day's honors comfortably. The hosts batted brilliantly to actually more than double the score after tea. Mendis' unbeaten knock stole the thunder from Bangladesh and he was class personified, going past his second 150-plus score. It was a flawless knock after the first-ball reprieve. Gunaratne's innings was equally impressive and although he couldn't get a century, the damage had been done by then. The duo's 196-run stand resurrected the innings after being 92/3 at one stage.
