Full around middle and leg, nudged towards short mid-wicket.
MEHEDI HASAN to bowl the final over of the day.

Comes from around the wicket for the last ball and tries to angle it in, Dickwella looks to work it away on the leg side but ends up playing a bit uppishly towards short mid-wicket. Luckily it falls safely.
Another short ball, angling in on the body, Mendis swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff! Good length ball, wide outside off, Dickwella stays put and smashes it through the left of the point fielder for a boundary.
Shortish in length and outside off, Nirsohan gets on top of the bounce and plays it with an angled bat towards Shakib at gully.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Dickwella arches back to evade it.

FOUR! Bashed! Roy hits the deck hard and Kusal was up for it. He knows this is not WACA or Centurion where the ball will come quickly on to the bat. Allows the ball to come and then unfurls a crackling pull shot to send it to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Brilliant!
Very full on the base of the stumps, it's jammed out to mid on.
Nips back in from outside off, KM covers the line and then leaves it alone.
Good length ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Boom! Fuller length ball outside off, a genuine half-volley, Mendis doesn't miss out on that one as he leans into it and drills it ever so delightfully through covers.
Harmless length ball outside off, Kusal leaves it alone.
On the hips, glanced down to long leg for another single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dickwella taps it towards the off side and they scamper through for a brisk single.
Served just ahead of a good length, Niroshan looks to go after it but once again gets beaten.
Good length ball on middle, defended from the crease.

A loud shout for a catch! On a length and angling across, Dickwella looks to slam it through point but is undone by the pace as the ball goes under his bat to Liton behind. Bangladesh appeal long and hard but umpire Erasmus stays unmoved. They think about the review but then decide against it. Good bowling this from Taskin!

FOUR LEG BYES! Taskin sprays it down the leg side, once again gets a good amount of bounce on it. Dickwella looks to help it on its way down the leg side but it goes off the thigh pad to the fence. 300 up for Sri Lanka!
Edged but safe! Good length ball, moving off the deck, Mendis looks to push it with soft hands but gets an outside edge which falls well short Mehedi at gully.
Roy looks to fire one on the pads but ends up bowling a bit too straight, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Driven through mid off for a single. Mahmudullah gets to the ball and doesn't throw. He knew no one is there to back up and is happy to keep it to himself.
Back of a length ball outside off, tapped in front of square on the off side for a single.
Strangles it down the leg side, Mendis looks to flick but fails to gets any bat on it. Liton dives to his left to stop it.

FOUR! My word, that's dispatched! First ball Dickwella is facing and gets a full ball on the pads, gets across a touch and whips it with strong bottom hand over mid-wicket for a boundary to get going.
NIROSHAN DICKWELLA is the new man in.

OUT! Gunaratne departs! Taskin Ahmed comes steaming in and serves a back of a length ball in the channel outside off, Asela looks to pull but isn't quite in full control. Gets an under edge as the ball goes on to disturb the timber. Taskin has his hands aloft as Bangladesh have finally broken a mammoth 196-run stand.
Very full and outside off, Mendis jams it out towards the off side for a single.
Beaten! Back of a length ball, just outside off, Mendis looks to poke at it but then sees the ball bouncing a bit more and hence withdraws the bat at the last moment.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Gunaratne flashes hard at it but gets beaten all ends up.
Good length ball, angling in, Mendis shoulders his arms.
Comes off the deck, it's on a shorter length, punched towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good length ball, nipping back in, Asela looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards the cover fielder.
Angles it in from outside off, Gunaratne shoulders his arms. The ball goes just past the off pole. Risky leave?
Asela once again stays back to this length ball and punches it straight to covers.
Good length ball, angling in, Gunaratne punches it off the back foot towards covers.
SUBASHIS ROY to share the second new ball.
Fuller outside off, actually wide outside off, no shot offered again from KM.
On a length and moving away a shade, once again Kusal lets it go through.
Fuller and moving away off the deck, easy leave for Mendis.
Good length ball on middle and off, worked off the back foot towards mid on.
Fuller on off, driven past the non-striker towards mid on.
Wide! Wayward! Fuller in length and it takes off the deck as it moves away sharply. Liton Das behind the stumps dives almost near the first slip and collects it.
Second new ball has been taken!
Fuller on off, Kusal comes forward and drives it straight to covers.
Second new ball is available now!

150 UP FOR MENDIS! Second time in Tests he has reached that mark. Short on the stumps, Mendis goes back and pulls it through square leg for a single. He raises the bat and acknowledges the cheer from the crowd! Well played, Kusal!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Gets forward to this tossed up ball and drives it to long off for a single. 1000 Test runs for Mendis, hopefully the start of what should be a long career.
Quicker around middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Flatter outside off, cut through point for an easy single.
Short and around off, punched down to long off for a single.
Quicker on middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket for one. 12 off the over!
FOUR! More runs, they keep coming! Hasan sends in a flatter ball outside off, gives enough time for Mendis to go back and crack it through covers for a boundary.

SIX! Wallop! Mehedi tosses it up outside off, Kusal Mendis sits down on one knee and murders the slog sweep off the meat of the bat as the ball sails over the mid-wicket fence for half a dozen. Runs coming thick and fast for the hosts here!
Pushed quicker through the air around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Flatter one around middle and leg, nudged around the corner for one.
Tossed up around middle and off, Gunaratne looks to flick but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
Good stop! Full around off, knocked to the left of Shakib who gets to his left quickly and stops it.
Tossed up around middle and off, Asela drives it towards Mahmudullah at mid on who doesn't attack this time. Collects the ball calmly and underarm throws it back to the bowler.
Darted around middle and leg, wristed behind square on the leg side for a single.
Lunges forward to this loopy ball and works it towards mid-wicket.
Short and flat around off, punched down to long off for a single.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards mid on for a single.
Flighted ball around off, Asela drives it back to the bowler who dives to stop it.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Around middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.

FIVE BONUS RUNS! It's Mahmudullah again! He is fuming at the fielder there, twice in two overs he has conceded a boundary on the overthrow! Asela pushes it towards mid on and sets off for a single. Mahmudullah fires in a throw at the bowler's end but misses and in fact there is no one backing up again and the ball races to the fence. Sri Lanka are getting free runs here.
On middle and leg, jammed towards short mid-wicket.
Mendis gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Slower through the air, defended down safely.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On middle and leg, nudged through backward square leg for a single.
Shorter around off, punched past covers for one.

SIX! Good use of the feet there! Shakib floats it up around middle and off, Mendis skips down the track, gets really close to the pitch of the ball and lofts it cleanly over mid on. It had enough meat to even clear the fence.
Tossed up outside off, Asela drives it inside out over extra cover for a single.

FIVE RUNS! Tossed up around middle and off, Gunaratne drives it down to long on and takes the single. The fielder fires in a wayward throw at the striker's end and Liton Das has no one behind him backing up. The ball goes to the fence.
On the pads, clipped towards short fine leg.
Comes from around the wicket and floats it up on the stumps, swept through backward square leg for another single.
Flattish on middle and leg, punched down to long on for a single.
Around middle and leg, tucked through square leg for one.
Tossed up around off, driven through covers for a single.
MEHEDI HASAN is back on!
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Darts it on middle, bunted towards mid on.
Flatter outside off, Mendis punches it towards Rahim at mid off who fumbles which allows them to pick up two.
Drops it short around off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Floats it up around off, Gunaratne comes down the track to defend.
FOUR! Classical! Rahman once again errs with his line. Sprays it on the pads, Mendis lunges forward, waits for it to come on the bat and nails it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Once again it's on a fuller length, Mendis drives it towards covers and sets off and then mid-way sends his partner back. Seeing the fielder fumbling he sets off again but the fielder was quick to deny them the single.
Fuller wide outside off, Mendis reaches out to that one and pats it towards short extra cover.
Fuller on the pads, clipped towards mid on for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, defended gently off the front foot.
Fuller and sprayed on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flighted ball around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Very full and around off, driven through covers for a single.
Drops it short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Drops it short outside off, stays back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Flatter outside off, gets back to cut but chops it towards point.
Drinks break....
Good length closer to off, nicely blocked by Mendis.
EDGED BUT SAFE! Length ball outside off, Mendis pokes at it and gets an edge but it just goes past the wide slip fielder. Rolls towards third man for a brace.
Fuller and outside off, Mendis shuffles across to that one and blocks solidly.
Keeps it well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length angled in from outside off, Mendis doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Full and outside off, reaches out and makes a leave to that one.
Quicker ball outside off, gets back to that one and defends it firmly towards the covers.
Flatter on middle, gets across to that one and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, rocks back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Floated outside off, reaches out and blocks solidly.
Tossed up and outside off, uses his feet and pats it back to the bowler. Single taken.
Flatter on middle, Gunaratne makes room and cuts it towards point. Single taken.
Another ball on the pads, easy pickings for Mendis who clips it through mid-wicket for a brace. Shoddy over from Mustafizur.
Full and outside off, Mendis reaches out and drives it firmly towards the covers.
Mustafizur is all over the place in this over, sprays it well down the leg side and Gunaratne deflects it towards fine leg for a single. Wanted the second run but Mendis denies.
FOUR! Fuller ball outside off, reaches out and drives it through the covers for a boundary. Crisply timed and another boundary for Gunaratne.
Full and outside off, leans forward and blocks it towards cover.
Starts with an erratic delivery way down the leg side, easily left alone by Asela.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN is back on.
Fuller on middle and leg, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, steps out to that one and blocks it towards cover.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
Flatter and on middle and leg, Gunaratne is struck on the pads as he misses the flick.
Fuller on middle, gets across and drives it towards mid on.
Floated outside off, gets back and dabs it towards point.
Fuller and around off, driven firmly down the ground to long on for a single.
2nd Test fifty for Gunaratne.
FOUR! SHOT! Very full and outside off, Gunaratne accepts the invitation to drive and pummels it through the covers for a boundary. It's been a very sensible knock from Sri Lanka's latest superstar.
Drifting in on middle, Gunaratne looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge to the off side.
Tossed up on middle, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted on middle, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off, leans across and blocks it towards the leg side.
Floated outside off, steps out to that one and smears it towards mid-wicket.
Full and on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and blocks it towards cover.
Slightly short outside off, rocks back and glides it towards point for a single.
Floated on a length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
SHAKIB AL HASAN has a change of ends.
Flighted on middle, gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short on middle, Mendis gets down on one knee and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker ball on a length around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Flighted and outside off, leans across and clips it gently towards short mid-wicket for a single.
A bit short and spinning in from around middle, Mendis stays back and tucks it with the turn through backward square leg for a single.
Floated around off, Mendis gets right behind the line and blocks solidly.
MAHMUDULLAH comes on to bowl.

NOT OUT! Sharp work by Das nevertheless. This was sliding down the leg side and Gunaratne missed the flick. Das did well to collect it and deflects the ball on to the stumps. They refer it upstairs but Gunaratne's foot had come down in time.
They are going upstairs to refer a stumping. Sharp work by Das but Gunaratne seemed okay in normal motion.
Full and outside off, Gunaratne squeezes it out towards mid off.
Fuller and outside off, reaches out and defends solidly.
Good length outside off, stays back and taps it towards point.
On middle and leg, Mendis tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
2nd Test ton for Mendis and 100-run stand comes up between Mendis and Gunaratne!

FOUR! FAB SHOT! Brings up the milestone in style. He was lucky not to get out first ball but has surely been flawless ever since. Superb knock! Coming to the delivery, it was a fuller ball but still had to be put away. Mendis merely pushes it past the bowler and has timed it so well that it beats mid off comfortably to the fence. Shot of the day! This has been fab partnership for the hosts.
Fuller and outside off, reaches out and blocks it well.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out and drives it towards short cover.
Drifting in from around off, reaches out and whips it away down to long on for a run.
Fuller on middle, Mendis leans into it and blocks solidly down the track.
FOUR! Poor ball! Half-tracker from Mehedi and a well-set Mendis isn't going to miss out at all. Rocks back and mauls the pull through mid-wicket to find the fence.
On a length around middle, Mendis gets down on knee and pulls it through square leg for a brace.
MEHEDI HASAN is back.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Fuller and outside off, gets across and drills it through mid on for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, Mendis leans into it and pushes gently towards cover.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Length ball very wide outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and on off, Mendis gets across and tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle and leg, Gunaratne tucks it to the leg side.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets well forward to that one and blocks solidly.
FOUR! CHEEKY! Floated around leg stump, Gunaratne brings out the reverse sweep and makes terrific connection. The ball speeds away to the square third man fence.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked gently towards the leg side.
Floated on the stumps, Gunaratne blocks it solidly from the crease.
Slightly short and outside off, Mendis rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length around off, stays back and punches it towards mid on.
Length ball but a bit too wide outside off to make the batsman play, no stroke offered by Asela.
Good length outside off, Gunaratne lets it pass through to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, keeps coming sharply with the angle, left alone by Asela.
Back of a length outside off, Gunaratne stays back and steers it just past the gully fielder towards the deep for a couple.
Not that erratic this time but still well wide outside off, another easy leave for Gunaratne.
Starts with a shocker, miles outside off and Das' flexibility was tested to the core, the young lad did well. Wide called.
SOUMYA SARKAR is introduced into the attack.
FOUR! SHOT! Quicker ball on middle and leg, Mendis gets down on one knee and nails the sweep through square leg to find the fence. Cracking stroke!

Slightly short outside off, Gunaratne sit back and glides it towards third man. Rahim puts in a good effort to prevent the boundary. They check it upstairs but it's a good effort. Three more to the total.
Flatter outside off, stays back and slaps it through the covers for a single.
Looped up outside off, Mendis uses his reach and essays another defensive stroke.
Fuller outside off, Mendis taps it towards the covers.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks.
Short of a length on middle, Gunaratne drags the pull towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Mendis drills it through the covers for a single.
Straying on the pads, Gunaratne clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length around the off stump, a bit of bounce and Gunaratne responds with a good leave.
Back of a length outside off, Gunaratne gets back and across to block it towards cover.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and blocks it well.
Floated outside off, Gunaratne steps out and pings it towards mid off for a sharp single. Good running, it's been a feature of this pair.
Loopy and closer to off, Asela gets forward and dead bats it towards cover.
Drifting in from around off, leans forward and pushes it to the bowler.
Fuller on the stumps, Gunaratne leans across and pats it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller on middle and leg, shuffles across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Dug in short outside off, the slowness of the pitch is such that Gunaratne almost hits the ball twice while trying to essay a forehand stroke. The ball goes off the bottom part of the bat.
FOUR! Elegant shot! Half-volley outside off, Gunaratne plays a silky drive through the covers. Timed it sweetly and the ball raced away to the fence. Taskin has overstepped, no ball given.
Another length ball , slightly wider this time, easily left alone to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length angled in on off, Mendis rises on his toes to work it through mid-wicket for a single.
Dug in short around off, Gunaratne stays back and shovels it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks solidly.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Slightly short outside off, gets back and cuts it towards point.
Loopy on middle and leg, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Quicker ball on middle, gets across to that one and pats it towards the bowler.
Flighted outside off, lunges and pushes it towards short cover.
SHAKIB AL HASAN to continue from the other end.
Fuller and outside off, a hint of reverse as Gunaratne lets it pass.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis works it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, dabbed towards first slip on the bounce.
Fuller ball on the stumps, pushed firmly towards mid on.

We are back for the final session. Bangladesh will need to break this partnership and make further inroads as otherwise this game could slip away from them. TASKIN AHMED to begin proceedings after tea.
... DAY 1, SESSION 3 ...

Good session for Sri Lanka. They did lose Chandimal cheaply but that was the only hiccup after lunch. Mendis grew in confidence and found an able partner in Gunaratne who has also looked at ease. Compared to the first session, Bangladesh's bowlers were lacking in accuracy and failed to create constant pressure on the batsmen. This pair will want to bat longer as batting will get difficult as the match progresses, so runs on the board is imperative. Can Bangladesh fight back? Join us in a short while to find out.
Short and outside off, Asela Gunaratne cuts it through short third man and comes back for a couple. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 1!
On middle and leg, defended in front of short leg.
Gives it a bit more flight and serves it around off, driven along the ground through covers for a single.
Full and fired around off, patted back to Shakib.
Goes back to this flat delivery and defends it with a straight willow.
Touch short and around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Loopy deliver around off, defended into the ground.
Floated ball around middle and off, pushed towards covers.
Gives it a lot of air, it's jammed down to mid on.
Tossed up around middle and off, Asela defends it down.
Full on the stumps, milked down to long on for a single.

Flatter and shorter outside off, Gunaratne slaps it past covers. The man stationed there reacts late and then goes chasing after the ball. Stops it just inside the rope as the pair runs three. 150 up for Lanka!
MEHEDI HASAN is back on.
Reaches out to this loopy ball outside off and gets it towards sweeper cover for one.
Floated ball around middle and off, defended by getting right behind it.
Pushes it slower through the air, Asela drives it towards covers.
Loopy outside off, buried into the ground.
Gives it a bit more flight around off, defended down effortlessly.

FOUR! More runs! Shakib doles out a short ball outside off, Asela Gunaratne makes full use of the crease. Goes deep and cuts it in front of square on the off side for a boundary. Runs coming easily at the moment for the home side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
50-run stand between Mendis and Gunaratne!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! All timing on that occasion! Fuller in length and angling in on middle and leg, Mendis gets across a touch and wrists it through mid-wicket for a glorious boundary.
FOUR! Mendis is dealing nicely with the short balls at the moment! Gets another one, swivels back and has enough time to pull it in front of square. Easily done!
Shortish ball on middle and leg, Mendis gets back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Fuller on the stumps, Mendis mistimes his drive to mid on.
Short and outside off, Kusal gets on top of the bounce and hits it firmly through backward point for a couple.
Flighted on middle and off, gets across and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Loopy and outside off, gets on the front foot and pats it towards the off side
Floated on middle and leg, gets across and clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Drifting in from outside off, gets well forward and pushes it towards the covers.
Quicker on a length around off, Mendis sits back and punches it towards cover.
Tossed up outside off, leans forward and drives towards cover.
Once again bowls a short ball, angling in on the body, pulled along the ground towards deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Hits the deck hard and it kicks off the turf, Kusal looks to pull that away but the ball goes well over him. The umpire calls it a wide.
Shortish on middle and leg, tapped towards the leg side off the back foot.
Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Mendis pulls it down to long leg for a couple.
Angles in a length ball on the body, AG swivels and pulls it in front of square for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Asela offers a solid defense.
Back of a length ball outside off, Gunaratne defends it off the back foot.
Fuller one around middle and leg, Mendis lunges forward, keeps his bat and pad together and defends.
Loopy ball outside off, Kusal takes a long stride forward and drives it straight to short extra cover.
Shortish on the stumps, tucked once more towards square leg.
Tossed up around middle and off, the batsman goes deep in the crease and clips it towards square leg again.
Flatter one down the leg side, flicked towards square leg.
Darts it around the pads, nudged behind square on the leg side for a single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is back.
Shortish outside off, Mendis gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Fuller on off, Asela drives it towards mid off for a quick single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards square leg for nothing.
Shortish outside off, steered nicely through point for a single. They look for the second but won't get it.
Back of a length ball on off, glided with an angled bat towards the off side.
FOUR! Just over! Fuller in length and outside off, Mendis just lofts it over extra cover. Didn't time it at all but luckily the ball sails over the man at extra cover and Kusal gets a boundary.

This one grips through the surface, turns in and Gunaratne clips it towards backward square leg. Mendis wanted the single but is sent back. There was a shy at the bowler's end and Mendis deliberately runs in the direction of the throw. Had that hit him on the body, he could have been given out obstructing the field.
Flattish through the air around middle and off, defended once again.
On middle and leg, Asela goes back and blocks.
FOUR! Short and quicker through the air outside off, Gunaratne camps back and cuts it beautifully through backward point for a rollicking boundary.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot nicely.
Short on middle and leg, Mendis sits down and pulls it through square leg for a single.
Sprays this one down the leg side, AG moves inside the line to let it be.
Rahman goes wide of the crease and angles it away from the batsman, Asela keeps it out off the front foot.
Goes back to over the wicket and bowls a fuller ball on off, Gunaratne drives it to mid off.
Touch short and served around off, punched towards mid off.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Angles in a length ball, it straightens a touch after pitching, Gunaratne is squared up as the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
Mendis goes back and turns it with the spin towards short leg.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Floated ball around off, Mendis gets down to sweep but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a couple.
Comes from over the wicket but drops it a bit short around middle and off, Asela gets back and cuts it late behind point. Rahim gives it a chase but they run three.
Tossed up around the stumps, driven towards mid on for a single.
4th Test fifty for Kusal Mendis!

FOUR! FIFTY FOR MENDIS! Slips it down the leg side, Mendis just works it delicately off the pads and the ball races down to the fine leg fence. He has made full use of the life that he got on the very first ball he faced.
Fuller in length and around off, Asela is solid in defense.
Comes from over the wicket and bowls it around the pads, AG gets across and defends it towards the right of the bowler.
Fuller outside off, nipping back in, Gunaratne covers the line and shoulders his arms.
In the channel outside off, the batsman has no trouble in letting it go.
Keeps it full again and outside off, Asela drives it straight to the man at mid off.
No ball! Very full outside off, Kusal gets forward and drives it through covers for a single. Another no ball as Mustafizur oversteps.

Falls short! Rahman goes wide of the crease and angles it in on middle, Mendis looks to flick it across the line but the ball bounces a bit more and he ends up getting a leading edge. Much to his delight the ball falls just short of a diving Mehedi at gully.
Loopy around off, defended into the ground.
Short and around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Flatter and quicker through the air, Gunaratne looks to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Slower through the air around off, blocked solidly.
Full around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Mendis gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
MEHEDI HASAN is back on, replacing Shakib!

FOUR! Gunaratne is off the mark! A low full toss by Rahman and Asela looks to drive it on the up by keeping his bat face open. He gets it off the slightly off the outside edge past gully for a boundary.
ASELA GUNARATNE walks in next!

OUT! What a catch by Mehedi! Rahman serves an off-cutter outside off, Chandimal just throws his bat at it without much footwork. An outside edge is induced which flies towards gully. Mehedi stationed there times his leap to perfection and takes a reverse cup catch over his head. The Bangla Tigers are delighted. Chandimal's scratchy innings comes to an end!
Very full and around off, driven straight to the man at short extra cover.
An off-cutter around off, defended gently by Chandimal.
Shortish around off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller in length and around off, Chandimal drives it towards mid off.
Drinks break...
Flatter outside off, stays back and defends solidly.
Quicker ball outside off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Flatter around leg, Chandimal looks to sweep but gets an under edge that goes through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and pats towards mid off.
Full and outside off, defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, hangs on the back foot and pushes it towards short cover.
Fuller ball outside off, defended off the front foot towards short cover.
Length ball outside off, moves away a bit with extra bounce as Mendis lets it pass.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Dug in short around off, Mendis stays on the back foot and plays a half-pull through mid-wicket. Struck it well and the ball raced away to the ropes. He is growing in confidence.
Around the wicket.
Back of a length around leg stump, clipped in front of square on the leg side and they pick up a sharp single.
Length ball around off, slanting across Chandimal who blocks it off the back foot towards cover.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN comes back.
Fuller on middle, Mendis gets across to that one and blocks towards short mid-wicket.
A bit short on middle, Mendis rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace as Mahmudullah tidies up near the ropes.
Drifting in from outside off, leans into it and taps gently towards cover.
Full and outside off, presses forward to that one and blocks solidly.
FOUR! Slightly short outside off, sits back and eases it through the covers with a punch for a boundary. Loose ball and Mendis was on it in a flash.
Flighted outside off, leans forward and drives it towards mid off.
Full and outside off, presses forward and pats it back to the bowler.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Chandimal ducks as the ball goes down the leg side. Another good take by Das diving to his left.
Good length just around off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and around off, gets across and blocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, extra bounce and it's a good take by Das diving to his right.
Back of a length on middle, gets back and clips it towards mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! NICELY STRUCK! Shortish on middle, Mendis swivels and pulls it away nicely in front of square on the leg side. Nicely done and it races away to the fence. Taskin has overstepped as well, no ball.
Slider outside off, Chandimal blocks firmly from the crease.
Fuller and outside off, Chandimal reaches out and drives it towards cover.
Quicker ball on leg stump, Chandimal misses the flick and is struck on the pads.
Loopy and outside off, Mendis uses his feet and pats it towards mid off for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, Mendis uses his feet and nudges it past silly point.
Flatter outside off, stays back and punches it to the covers.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Good length outside off, Chandimal steers it towards point.
Back of a length around off, Chandimal is struck high on the thigh pad as he looks to block.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal blocks firmly from the crease to the off side.
Good length outside off, nips in a bit as Chandimal lets it pass.
Drifting in from outside off, solid front foot defence from Mendis.
Quicker ball outside off, Mendis leans forward and defends solidly.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, worked on to the leg side.
Full and outside off, reaches out to that one and defends solidly.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Short and wide outside off, Mendis cuts it through backward point. Nicely done and he will pick up three more.
Shortish around off, Mendis looks to cut but is cramped for room. The ball hits the bat handle and rolls to the off side.
Full and around off, leans into it and pushes firmly towards mid on.
Back of a length outside off, hits high on the bat as Mendis defends from the crease to cover.
Good length outside off, Mendis stands tall and blocks solidly towards cover.
TASKIN AHMED is back on. A slip, gully and a leg gully in place.
Another loopy ball outside off, Chandimal is happy leaving those alone.
Very full and around off, driven firmly to short extra cover who gets a hand on it to make a half stop.
Drifting in from outside off, Dinesh plays an angled bat towards point.
Flatter and angled in from around off, slightly short and Chandimal punches it past extra cover.
Once again bowled slower through the air outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Floated up around off, Chandimal gets on the front foot and defends it solidly on to the track.
Back of a length around off, stands tall and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Full and on off, a bit of inswing as Mendis shuffles across to pat it towards mid on.
Back of a length wider outside off, extra bounce as Mendis lets it pass.
FOUR! CREAMED! Overpitched outside off, Mendis leans into it and eases the drive straight back past the bowler. Mid off had no chance and it raced away to the fence in no time. Classy shot!
Fuller and attacking the stumps, Mendis gets across and blocks solidly down the pitch.
Good length around off, dabbed with an angled bat towards gully.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pats it towards cover.
Quicker and fuller on the pads, worked away wide of the mid on fielder for a couple.
Looped up well around off, Chandimal defends with his bat and pad close together.
Tossed up on a length on off, pushed gently back to the bowler off the back foot.
Slider just outside off, that's a good leave from Chandimal.
Darted in from around off, leans forward and pushes firmly towards point.
Good ball! The inswinger comes in a bit sharply as Mendis lets it pass through to the keeper.
Full and around off, Mendis gets the big stride forward and pushes it towards cover.
Fuller ball just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Nice inswinger around off, squares up Mendis who pushes tentatively at it. The edge goes to gully on the bounce.
Beaten! Length ball outside off, Mendis' feet have gone nowhere as he flashes wildly at it. The ball keeps a touch low and ends up going past the outside edge.
Good length outside off, stays back and blocks solidly with the full face of the blade.
Fuller around off, leans across and pats it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks firmly.
Drifting in from outside off, Chandimal pats it towards cover.
Floated on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, gets across and tucks it to the leg side.
Flatter around off, blocked solidly from the crease.

Huge appeal turned down! Fuller ball around off, shapes in a bit to ping Chandimal on the front pad. Loud, loud appeal for lbw but the umpire says no. There was a faint inside edge and that saved Dinesh. Bangladesh think of a review but then decide against it. Considering their recent bizarre reviews, one would think they may have gone upstairs for this but sanity prevails.
Good length on middle and leg, gets back and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Pitched up outside off, Chandimal gets the stride in and pushes the ball towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover. Slight fumble from the fielder and that allows the single.
Length ball outside off, a bit of away movement and bounce as Mendis taps it with an angled bat to backward point.
Good length closer to off, defends it well from the crease.
SUBASHIS ROY to continue from the other end.
Nicely tossed up around off, Chandimal looks to drive but gets it off the inside half towards short leg.
Drifting in from outside off, leans into it and pushes gently towards point.
Drags it short on middle, Mendis sits back and pulls it powerfully to deep mid-wicket. Just a single as Mahmudullah was quick to swoop in on the ball.
Quicker ball on the pads, Mendis gets across and tucks it towards square leg.
Flighted fuller on the stumps, presses forward and defends well.
Flatter around off, stays back and blocks it well.

Welcome back for the second session. Bangladesh know that they are a wicket away from having a crack at Sri Lanka's inexperienced batsmen. Mendis and Chandimal have a big task in their hands. The visitors begin with Shakib Al Hasan first up. Here we go!!!
.....DAY 1, SESSION 2.....

Even session to start the Test although Bangladesh will marginally be the happier side after losing the toss. Sri Lanka started badly losing Tharanga cheaply and almost lost Mendis next ball but the latter survived due to a no ball. He has looked solid since, playing some pleasing shots. Karunaratne dug in but was removed just before lunch by Mehedi. The pick of the bowlers was Roy who got some movement off the deck and was accurate too. With a batsman short, Sri Lanka need the current pair to bat long. Join us in a short while for the second session.
Fuller in length and moves away slightly, Dinesh Chandimal lunges forward to block but gets an outside edge which falls well short of the man at gully. A maiden for Roy and THAT WILL BE LUNCH!
On a length and just around off, Dinesh prods forward and blocks it out.
Chandimal is clearly playing for lunch. He doesn't want to try anything. Gets another length ball, he defends it with a straight bat.
Back of a length ball, kicking off the deck, Chandimal hops and fends it away.
Good length ball outside off, Chandimal defends it down by pressing forward.
Fuller in length on off, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. A good over from Hasan as he got a breakthrough.
A quicker one around middle, skidding through the surface, Dinesh looks to flick but closes the bat face early, gets a leading edge as the ball rolls towards backward point.
Fuller around middle, punched back to the right of the bowler.
DINESH CHANDIMAL walks in next, replacing Karunaratne!

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Mehedi Hasan is pumped up! To be honest he has got a wicket on a nothing delivery. He sends in a flatter one around off, Dimuth Karunaratne stays put and looks to cut it through the off side, gets cramped for room and as a result gets an inside edge on the stumps. Bangladesh have struck just before lunch.
Quicker through the air around off, Dimuth gets back and once again defends it towards the short leg fielder.
Flatter one around off, defended towards the man at short leg.
Shortish in length and on middle and leg, Dimuth swivels a touch and pulls it down to long leg for one.
Fuller in length and around off, defended off the front foot.
Mendis wants to change his bat and signals it towards the dressing room...
Touch fuller around off, Mendis comes half forward and pushes it towards covers for a single.
An overpitched ball on off, driven sweetly past covers for a brace.
Very close to the off stump line, Kusal offers not stroke to that one.
Beaten! Hurls in a length ball around off and gets it to move off the deck, Mendis gets back to hit it through the line but is undone by the away movement there.
SUBASHIS ROY is back.

Touch short around middle and leg, Dimuth pats it towards point and wants a single. He is sent back as the fielder charges towards the ball. He has a shy at the striker's end and it hits. They appeal but Dimuth made it back in time.
Once again tossed up around off, it's pushed back to Mehedi.
Floats it up around off, Karunarante comes forward and bunts it back to the bowler.
Flatter through the air around off, DK leaves it alone.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Dimuth works it past short leg and comes back for a double.
Drifting in from around off, hit towards backward point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Comes from around the wicket, bowls a full ball, it's kept out with a solid defense.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dimuth taps it towards point and looks to cross. Mahmudullah gets to the ball and throws it at the bowler's end. It hits but the batsman was easily in.
Half stop from Mahmudullah! A length ball outside off, Karunaratne cuts it nicely towards point where Mahmudullah dives to his left but the ball goes through his hands and they take a couple of runs.
Another full ball on middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Another short ball around middle, Kusal goes back, looks to pull but finds Taskin at backward square leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shortish and flatter one around middle, Mendis sweeps it towards square leg.
Floats it up around off, Dimuth pushes it towards Taskin at backward point. They look to steal a single as the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Full around middle and leg, Dimuth looks to flick but it hits the man at short leg.
Tossed it up around off, a touch shorter as well, Karunaratne dabs it behind point for a couple.
Time for spin, MEHEDI HASAN to roll his arm over! A slip and short leg in place.
Fuller outside off, Mendis leaves it alone.
This one holds its line, Kusal just about brings his bat in time and defends.
On the leg stump, worked off the pads towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Cracking! A length ball wide outside off, Mendis sees an opportunity to score, gets back and flays it past point for a lovely boundary.
Length ball on middle and leg, Mendis looks to flick but the ball bounces a bit more, hits him high on the bat. Gets a safe leading edge towards covers.
Good running! Fuller length delivery on off, Karunarante pushes it tamely towards mid off and gets towards the other end in a jiffy.
Fuller on off, driven off the front foot towards mid off for nothing.
Shortish once again and served outside off, Kusal doesn't look at it.
FOUR! Controlled shot! Taskin shortens the length and gives a bit of width, Mendis hops, opens the bat face and hits it over backward point for a boundary.
Fuller in length, around off, pushed off the front foot towards Taskin.
Back of a length ball outside off, it's left alone without much fuss.
Good length ball, coming in nicely with the angle, Mendis looks to clip it but is beaten for pace and gets an inside edge on the pads.
A length ball, served on off, Dimuth gets back and pushes it towards mid off this time. A maiden for Rahman!
Good length ball, close to the off stump channel, punched towards mid on by the southpaw.
Pitches it up outside off, Dimuth presses forward and drives it towards mid off.
Good length ball on the hips, tucked towards the square leg fielder.
Fuller and coming in with the angle, Dimuth looks to work it on the leg side but gets it off the inner half of the bat as the ball rolls towards mid on.

A shout for an LBW, turned down! Rahman goes wide of the crease from over the wicket and angles in a full ball on middle and leg. Karunaratne looks to flick it across the line but misses and is rapped on the pads. Rahman appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Probably going down leg.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN is back into the attack!
Mendis gets behind the line, lunges a bit and defends it back down the wicket.
Hits the deck hard and the ball rises off the deck, the angle is down the leg side which allows the batsman to duck under it.
Fuller in length and angling in, Mendis bends forward and defends it towards the cover region. They look for the single but then decide against it.
On a length and just outside off, Kusal shoulders his arms to that one.
Back of a length ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR LEG BYES! Taskin comes steaming in and angles in a length ball on leg, Mendis looks to help it on its way fine down the leg side but misses. It hits his thigh pad and Liton Das behind the stumps dives full length to his left but fails to collect it. The ball races down to the fine leg fence.
Switches the angle, comes from around the wicket, this one nips back in a bit from around off, DK gets behind it and defends it towards mid on.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Karunaratne ducks to evade it.
Keeps it full around the off stump channel, Dimuth gets forward and bunts it straight to mid on.
Fuller outside off, Dimuth presses forward and defends it down solidly.
Fuller in length and on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length ball outside off, Karunaratne goes back and taps it towards the off side. Mendis calls for the single and gets it comfortably in the end. Good running!
Fuller and sprayed outside off, DK shoulders his arms to that one.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dimuth gets behind the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller in length and slanting across the batsman who doesn't offer any stroke.
Angles in a length ball around off, Mendis goes back, taps it towards covers and scampers through for a quick single.
Leg bye! A length ball, drifting down the leg side, Karunaratne looks to clip it away on the leg side but it goes off the pads and they collect a leg bye.
Drinks are on the field!
Good length closer to off, defends it solidly from the crease.

FOUR! Wrong line and punished! Probably one of the rare bad balls that Roy has bowled today. Drifts down the leg side and Mendis gets a faint tickle on it. Nice deflection and gets it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Dug in short around off, Mendis ducks under it with ease.
Fuller on off, leans forward and drives it firmly back to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
On middle and leg, Mendis gets across and tucks it towards the leg side.
Dug in short around off, Karunaratne evades the bumper.
Hits the deck hard and gets the line on middle, gets across and defends solidly towards the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, Karunaratne stands tall and dabs it towards the gully region.
Short of a length around off, Dimuth looks to play a short arm jab but gets a faint inside edge that thuds into his thigh.
Fullish ball outside off, bunted firmly towards extra cover.
Good length angled across the left-hander, Karunaratne lets it pass.
TASKIN AHMED is back.
Shortish length around off, blocked solidly from the crease towards cover. Single taken.
Fullish on leg stump, leans across and jams it towards mid-wicket.
Overpitched ball outside off, Mendis caresses it through the covers with lovely timing. Pleasant shot and he will get off the mark with a three to his name.
Fuller ball on the fourth stump line, left alone to the keeper.
Fullish and outside off, crisply driven towards short extra cover.
Fuller on off, gets forward and drives it towards mid on.
Very full and around off, gets across and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Dimuth lifts his bat to let it pass.
Length ball outside off, angling in, left alone to the keeper.
Good length on off, gets across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, sits back and offers the full face of the blade.
Fuller and outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks it towards cover.
Dug in short on middle, Mendis squats to let the bumper over his head.
The pattern continues. Mendis shoulders arms to another length ball around off stump.
Another good length ball outside off, Mendis continues to leave those.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Mendis makes a leave to that one.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller and outside off, Dimuth gets the big stride forward and eases it towards extra cover.
Full and on off, leans across to that one and pushes it towards mid on.
FOUR! Off the edge but in the gap! Fuller ball outside off, Karunaratne pushes hard at it and gets a thickish edge that flies between third slip and gully. Another lucky boundary for the southpaw.
Back of a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Dimuth shoulders arms to that one.
Straying on the pads, Karunaratne gets across and clips it through backward square leg for a brace.
Full and outside off, Mendis crisply drives it towards mid off.
Fuller and just outside off, no stroke offered to that one.

TRAGEDY FOR ROY! He took another wicket, only to see himself overstepping on the replays. Length ball outside off, nips in a bit as Mendis pushes at it. Gets a thin inside edge that is taken by Das with ease. Clearly there is a nick but the umpires refer it upstairs to check the no ball. Roy has indeed overstepped and the celebrations are cut short for the Bangladeshis. Can Mendis make use of this life?
Roy has taken another but they are checking for the no ball.
KUSAL MENDIS walks in next, replacing Tharanga!

OUT! BOWLING CHANGE WORKS! Roy strikes in his very first over. Full and around off, nips back in off the seam as Tharanga plays around it with zero footwork. The ball gets through him to rattle the timber. Roy is jumping around in delight and seems unstoppable in his celebration. Wonder how will it be if he gets a 5-fer!
Back of a length outside off, stays back and plays with an angled bat towards gully on the bounce.
Around leg stump, Tharanga is struck on the pads as he misses the flick. The ball probably kept a bit low. There is a stifled appeal for lbw but it pitched outside leg.
Slips it well down the leg side, Tharanga looks to clip it away but misses.
SUBASHIS ROY into the attack now!
Ends the over with a harmless length ball wider outside off, easy leave for the batsman.
On the pads, Karunaratne gets back and tucks it towards square leg.
Length ball wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, solid back foot defense by Karunaratne.
Length ball slanting in from outside off, Karunaratne looks to play across the line but is struck on the thigh pad as the ball rolls to cover.
Good length outside off, stays back and blocks solidly.
Keeps it outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Good length on middle, works it to the leg side. Thought of the single but decides against it.
Strays down the leg side, Dimuth looks to flick it away but misses.
A bit full and just outside off, probing delivery and Karunaratne lets it pass.
FOUR! Squares him up! Back of a length on leg stump, Karunaratne looks to block off the back foot and gets an edge that goes on the bounce past third slip for a boundary. Streaky runs for Dimuth.
Good length slanting well across the left-hander, that's a very easy leave for Karunaratne.

FOUR! Sweetly driven! Fuller but there is a tinge of width on offer, Tharanga leans into it and drives it through extra cover. Through the gap and away she races for a boundary. First one of the match, that!

A loud shout for LBW! Fuller and angling in from around off, Tharanga looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. They appeal for an LBW but umpire Erasmus says not out. Replays show there was a thick inside edge there.
Fuller once again in the channel outside off, Tharanga sholders his arms to that one. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Beaten! Rahman goes wide of the crease and serves a full ball, angling in, Upul once again comes forward to defend  but gets beaten.
Fuller in length and nipping back in a shade, Tharanga prods forward to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Fuller in length and angling in, Dimuth gets forward and drives it down the ground. Mid on gives it a chase and keeps them down to three.
Keeps it outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and outside off, presses forward to that one and blocks it solidly.
Beaten! Keeps it very full outside off, Tharanga is rooted to the crease and looks to drive with hard hands. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Slips it down the leg side, Tharanga looks to flick but misses.
Taskin gets his line and length right this time. Probing length ball closer to off, nips in a touch with bounce as Tharanga makes a good leave.
Drifts on to the pads, Karunaratne tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Starts with a length ball that is way outside off, too wide even by Test match standards and is signaled by the umpire.

MIX UP AND ALMOST A WICKET! Poor running from the opening pair but they get away eventually. Fuller ball around off, Karunaratne pushes it gently towards cover. There was confusion in the running but they eventually get the single as Rahim fumbles a bit at cover.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, Karunaratne rises on his toes and taps it towards cover.
Good length around off, Karunaratne stays on the back foot and blocks it firmly down the track.
Play and a miss! Didn't take Karunaratne long to fish at one. Another length ball on fifth stump line, Dimuth hangs his bat at it and is lucky not to get a nick.
Good length in the corridor of uncertainty, slightly coming in with the angle, Karunaratne lets it pass.
Length ball outside off, no real movement off the surface, left alone to the keeper.

All set for play to begin as the players and umpires make their way out to the middle. UPUL THARANGA and DIMUTH KARUNARATNE to open the batting for Sri Lanka. It shall be MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN to take the new ball. He has three slips and a gully in place. Here we go!
The players are out there for their respective National Anthems.

MUSHFIQUR RAHIM accepts that it is a good pitch and says that he would have batted first as well. Feels that the track will take spin as the game progresses. States that Bangladesh are playing three pacers and two spinners. Feels that his side has a good chance this time as they are having a full strength side with all key players fit.

RANGANA HERATH feels that it is a good pitch and says that Sri Lanka will bat. Reveals that they are playing three specialist spinners and two pacers. Hopes that his side can maintain their good form at home.
TOSS - SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says that there is a nice covering of grass but it will only serve to hold the surface together. Should be a good batting pitch and the spin should come into play after the first three days. The seamers should get some help on the first two days.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of Bangladesh's tour of Sri Lanka. The first of the two Tests is set to begin in Galle. Considering the inexperience and lack of stability in the Lankan ranks, it would be fair to say that this is Bangladesh's best chance of beating the Islanders. However, as Australia found out last year, it isn't easy to win against the Lankans in their den. Bangladesh are a better side though for these conditions and we can expect an interesting series if the Tigers play to potential. Stay tuned as the toss isn't far away.
